title: Near-Optimal Learning of Gaussian Sobolev Operators
abstract: arXiv:2607.11921v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: A key question in operator learning is how to design surrogate operators with provable approximation guarantees in reasonable computational time. Whereas holomorphic operators can be approximated efficiently, i.e., with at least algebraic convergence in the number of training samples, learning finitely regular operators is known to be less efficient. The reason is an intrinsic curse of sample complexity, which allows only subalgebraic convergence rates. This fact makes it all the more important to develop algorithms which provably achieve these rates. In this work, we present a fully data-driven algorithm, termed Hermite-PCA approximation, for learning Gaussian Sobolev operators with near-optimal sample complexity. It employs principal component analysis and weighted least-squares methods and is therefore computationally efficient. translated_title: 高斯索博列夫算子的近最优学习
translated_abstract: 算子学习中的一个关键问题是如何在合理的计算时间内设计具有可证明逼近保证的代理算子。虽然全纯算子可以被高效逼近，即随着训练样本数量的增加至少具有代数收敛性，但已知学习有限正则性的算子效率较低。其原因在于样本复杂度的内在“维数灾难”，这使得只能达到低于代数的收敛速率。这一事实使得开发能够可证明地达到这些速率的算法变得更加重要。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种完全数据驱动的算法，称为 Hermite-PCA 逼近，用于以近最优的样本复杂度学习高斯索博列夫算子。该算法采用主成分分析和加权最小二乘方法，因此计算效率高。此外，它是谱方法意义上的算法，即随着……可实现更快（且近最优）的收敛。
tldr: 本文提出了 Hermite-PCA 逼近算法，一种采用主成分分析与加权最小二乘的完全数据驱动且计算高效的方法，能以近最优的样本复杂度学习高斯索博列夫算子。
en_tdlr: We propose Hermite-PCA approximation, a fully data-driven and computationally efficient algorithm combining PCA and weighted least squares, which learns Gaussian Sobolev operators with near-optimal sample complexity.
